title: Workstations
description: Manage remote workstations for agents to run commands: a direct SSH host, or a container runtime on a remote host reached over SSH.
emptyDescription: Add a workstation to allow agents to run commands on remote machines.

createDialog.title: Add Workstation
createDialog.description: Configure a new remote workstation connection.
createDialog.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens. Used by agents to reference this workstation.
createDialog.privateKeyHint: Pasted key material is encrypted at rest and never returned by the API.
createDialog.imageHint: Execution always passes --pull=never, so this image must already exist in the runtime on the remote host. The gateway never pulls it for you.
createDialog.runtimeHint: Automatic resolution uses podman when it is installed, and only falls back to docker with the opt-in below. Executions run with --network=none, so the workload has no network access.
createDialog.allowRootfulHint: A rootful docker daemon socket hands the workload host root even when the SSH user is not root. Enable only if you accept that.
createDialog.rootfulRequiredWarning: docker is selected but the rootful socket is not accepted. Pick podman, or turn the option on above to accept the risk.

errors.sshHostUserRequired: Host and SSH user are required for the SSH backend.
errors.sshPrivateKeyRequired: A private key is required for key-based authentication.
errors.sshPasswordRequired: A password is required for password authentication.
errors.dockerImageRequired: Image is required for the container backend.
errors.dockerRootfulRequired: The docker runtime needs the rootful docker socket option enabled.
errors.hostFingerprintShape: The fingerprint must start with "SHA256:" followed by 43 base64 characters.
errors.hostCaKeyShape: The CA key must be one authorized_keys line, for example "ssh-ed25519 AAAA… comment".
errors.hostCaKeyNotSingleLine: The CA key must be a single line, with no line breaks.
errors.hostCaKeyIsPrivateKey: That looks like a private key. Paste the CA's public key instead — never a private key.

deleteDialog.title: Delete Workstation
deleteDialog.description: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.

testResult.title: Connection test
testResult.hint: Dials the host over SSH and checks the transport. For a remote container it also resolves the runtime and confirms the pinned image is present. This can take a few seconds.
testResult.imageAbsent: not present on the remote host
testResult.rootfulWarning: The resolved runtime is a rootful docker daemon: it delegates host root even to a non-root user.
testResult.legacyTitle: This workstation predates the SSH transport
testResult.legacyReason: It was created before the container backend moved onto SSH, so it has no host, user or credentials and cannot be opened or tested. Re-create it as a remote container workstation.

activity.title: Recent Activity
activity.emptyDescription: Exec events will appear here once agents run commands.

hostTrust.sectionHint: How this workstation proves it is the host you meant to reach.
hostTrust.fingerprintHint: Pins one exact host key. Best when the host's key never changes. Get it from the server with "ssh-keygen -lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub".
hostTrust.caKeyHint: Trusts any host certificate signed by this CA. Best when hosts are rebuilt — the host key changes, but the CA that signs it does not.
hostTrust.precedenceHint: Both are set: the CA key is checked first, then the fingerprint.
hostTrust.noAnchorWarning: No host verification set. With nothing here, the gateway refuses to connect to this workstation — the command will fail with "refusing connection: no host trust anchor configured". Add a fingerprint or a CA key, or turn on insecure mode below.
hostTrust.insecureHint: Accepts any host key on first contact. Every connection logs a security warning and can be redirected by anyone on the network path.
hostTrust.insecureWarning: Host verification is off. Do not use this for anything but local development.

editDialog.title: Edit workstation
editDialog.description: Change the display name and host verification settings. Stored credentials are left as they are.
editDialog.trustUnavailable: Host verification settings aren't available for this workstation type, so they're left untouched. The gateway still uses the anchor it stored at creation.
